ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low-intensity pixels (black/dark grey) dominate approximately 90% of the fluke area, with high-intensity pixels (white/light grey) localized in discrete spots and linear marks creating high local contrast.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: A continuous low-intensity black field serves as the base. Distinct high-intensity white circular blobs (approximate diameter 10-20 pixels) are non-uniformly distributed across both lobes. Dense high-intensity pixel clusters are mapped specifically to the distal tips of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 52 degrees, extending downward to about 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (2-6 pixel depth) along the trailing boundary. The right lobe inner margin exhibits three distinct larger semi-circular indentations (notches).
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: A predominantly concave curve along the trailing edge that transitions to a sharp convex curve at the tips, forming a tapered, hooked profile.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatially discrete white circular clusters (barnacle colonization) are visible: 4 prominent clusters on the left lobe mid-section and 5 on the right lobe mid-section, with high-density aggregation along the outer distal margins.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct high-contrast linear pixel disruptions on the right lobe, including a primary vertical line (approx. 80 pixels in length) and a secondary diagonal line intersecting it.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent white cross-shaped (X-pattern) scar is located on the upper quadrant of the right lobe; significant calcified barnacle clusters are visible on the extreme outer edges.
other_distinctive_markers: Parallel vertical white linear streaks near the base of the median notch, contrasting sharply with the surrounding dark pigmentation.
